newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecomm to meet $0.92 estimate in '97.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecomm to meet $0.92 estimate in '97.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Tuesday it expects earnings for its fiscal 1997 year to end October 31, 1997 to meet the $0.92 a share mean estimate provided by analysts.

"We're pretty comfortable with that," said William Cadogan, chief executive officer. "...If you look at our track record, we've generally managed to meet those objectives and we expect we'll do that again in 1997," he told reporters after the company's annual shareholders meeting here.
Last year, ADC earned $0.68 a share.

The estimate excludes an $0.11 a share non-recurring charge taken in the company's fiscal first quarter. The charge covered a write-off for purchased research and development resulting from ADC's acquisition of the wireless infrastructure group of Pacific Communication Services Inc and expenses related to consolidation of ADC's West Coast operations.
Commenting on further expansion, Cadogan said that although the company may have additional acquisitions in 1997, "We wont see anything close to the eight acquisitions we had in 1996."
Cadogan told shareholders that sales growth in fiscal 1997 is expected to match the growth in fiscal 1996 which showed an increase of 41 percent to $828 million.
"1996 performance is likely to carry forward into 1997," he said.
ADC provides connectivity, transmission and networking products for broadband global networks.
